# CarbonM FuelMax Technology Private Limited
Website: https://carbonmfuel.com/
Official company summary: CarbonM develops industrial fuel (FuelMax) and circular naphtha (NovaNaph) from difficult plastic waste.
Products: https://carbonmfuel.com/outputs
FuelMax: upgraded hydrocarbon fuel for industrial boiler/furnace applications, subject to specific fuel-system qualification.
NovaNaph: circular naphtha-range hydrocarbons for petrochemical applications, subject to downstream qualification and certification.
Technologies: https://carbonmfuel.com/technology
YieldBoost: physics-informed process optimisation targeting C5-C20 hydrocarbon vapour selectivity. https://carbonmfuel.com/technology/yieldboost
Magnet: downstream oil upgrading and contaminant reduction. https://carbonmfuel.com/technology/magnet
Customer value: https://carbonmfuel.com/why-us
Operations: Shamirpet, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Registered office: W-54 Rakesh Kapoor Innovation Centre, BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus, Rajasthan 333031, India.
Potential fuel-related downtime reductions are targets requiring customer-site validation. Regulatory benefits depend on eligibility, lifecycle accounting, applicable jurisdiction and certifications.
Contact: https://carbonmfuel.com/contact
